---
name: A finding
about: You saw something that is wrong, missing, or contradicts something else
labels: []
---

<!-- This is the contribution this project most wants. The bar is *did you see
     something real*, not *did you write it up well* — one sentence is a complete
     issue, and no implementation proposal is required. -->

## What you saw

<!-- Where, and what happened. An endpoint, an MCP tool, a page, a document. -->

## When

<!-- The date, and the time if it matters. Every measurement in this project
     carries the date it was measured, because a claim without one cannot be
     re-checked or aged out. -->

## What you expected instead

<!-- One line is enough. If you are not sure what the right behaviour is, say
     that — two documents disagreeing is itself a finding, and `docs/decisions.md`
     already records several. -->

## Anything you already checked

<!-- Optional. `npm run check` output, a request and its response, a snippet.
     A report with nothing here is still worth having. -->
